text:
After spending a few years searching for a new dental clinic — since my old one stopped providing tartar removal services unless I underwent orthodontic treatment with them — I finally found an excellent option called “Tooth Journey Dental Clinic”!

One of the main reasons I chose this clinic is that it’s a recently opened premium dental clinic owned by my high school friend, Dr. Nara Suriyajakyuthana. She has nearly 15 years of experience running two other successful dental clinics.

When I arrived at the clinic, I was amazed by its luxurious, spacious, and impeccably clean design. They offer complimentary cold bottled water, milk, and even hot coffee made with a capsule coffee machine. Since the clinic also specializes in pediatric dentistry, there’s a dedicated playground in one corner featuring a ball pit, slide, and plenty of toys. I’m confident any child would have a joyful experience here. The modern, stylishly designed restroom also impressed me — it truly stole my heart.

Dr. Nara carefully recommended the EMS airflow dental package, which she believed was the most suitable for me. She started by applying a dye to my teeth to highlight areas of plaque, clearly showing which parts I wasn’t cleaning properly. To my surprise, I discovered that while I was thoroughly cleaning the front surfaces of my teeth, the areas near the necks of my teeth were much dirtier, as revealed by the dark purple dye. Dr. Nara even used a tooth model to teach me how to properly clean these neglected areas.

Next, to deeply clean the small channels between each pair of teeth, the package included an air-flow treatment, which uses a stream of air to clean these spaces without needing dental floss.

Additionally, the clinic offered two types of tartar scrapers: a traditional one with consistent vibration speed and a new Artificial Intelligence (AI) tartar scraper from Switzerland, which automatically adjusts its vibration strength based on the thickness of the tartar. With only a minimal price difference, I eagerly opted to try the advanced AI technology. It turned out to be the right decision, as it was probably the smoothest tartar-scraping experience I’ve ever had, leaving my teeth perfectly clean!

Since I wasn’t using dental floss, Dr. Nara suspected I might have tooth decay in the areas where teeth touch each other — spots not visible to the naked eye. The only way to check was through an X-ray, which I decided to take. Living in the US, where dental services are extremely expensive, and visiting Thailand only once a year for about a month, I wanted to ensure everything was thoroughly checked. Again, it was the right decision — the X-ray revealed accumulated tartar in the spaces between my teeth, with some pieces even buried deep in my gums. Fortunately, Dr. Nara cleaned everything in time, preventing gum inflammation. She also used a tooth model to teach me how to properly use dental floss for cleaning between my teeth.

Since I only visit Thailand once a year, I prioritize finding a dental clinic that provides high-quality service to help maintain my teeth throughout the year while I’m in the US. Based on this fantastic first experience, I’ll definitely return next year!

As Tooth Journey Dental Clinic is newly opened, they’re offering many attractive promotions and discounts — so be sure to check them out!
